The PR moves the only lemma involved (`normalizer_inf_normalizer_le_normalizer_sup`) *out* of Pointwise into `Subgroup/Basic.lean`, which Pointwise already imports. claim: `commutator_sup_left` states the distributivity only for a binary sup `⁅H ⊔ K, N⁆ = ⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆`. The same argument proves it for an arbitrary indexed supremum `⁅⨆ i, H i, N⁆ = ⨆ i, ⁅H i, N⁆` when `N` is normal, and the binary statement follows from that in one line.
requested_change: Add `theorem commutator_iSup_left {ι : Sort*} (H : ι → Subgroup G) (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] : ⁅⨆ i, H i, N⁆ = ⨆ i, ⁅H i, N⁆`, proved like the current argument with `M := (⨆ i, H i) ⊔ N` and a private auxiliary lemma for the case where `⨆ i, ⁅H i, N⁆` is normal. Then derive the binary version: `theorem commutator_sup_left ... := by simpa [iSup_bool_eq] using commutator_iSup_left (fun b : Bool ↦ cond b H K) N` (and `commutator_sup_right` as now).
evidence: lean_verify_edit replacing lines 326-358 of Mathlib/GroupTheory/Commutator/Basic.lean with a private `commutator_iSup_left_aux`, `commutator_iSup_left` (same structure as the PR proof: `iSup_le`, `map_iSup`, `le_iSup`; the `N ≤ normalizer` step done by `rw [mem_normalizer_iff_map_conj_eq, map_iSup]; exact iSup_congr fun i ↦ mem_normalizer_iff_map_conj_eq.mp (normalizer_commutator_ge_right (H i) N hg)`), the one-line binary `commutator_sup_left` via `iSup_bool_eq`, and the unchanged `commutator_sup_right`: outcome `compiled`, no errors. declaration_search: `Subgroup.commutator_iSup_left` exists neither at the base commit nor in the PR. A side effect is that the indexed proof does not use `inf_normalizer_le_normalizer_sup`.

claim: `commutator_mono_left` and `commutator_mono_right` only instantiate the existing `commutator_mono` with `le_rfl`. They exist so that `gcongr` and `grw` can use them, but tagging `commutator_mono` itself with `@[gcongr]` already lets `gcongr` vary either argument alone, so the two new lemmas are redundant.
requested_change: Change `commutator_mono`'s attribute to `@[to_additive (attr := gcongr)]` and delete `commutator_mono_left` and `commutator_mono_right`. In `commutator_sup_left'`, write the lower bound as `sup_le (by gcongr; exact le_sup_left) (by gcongr; exact le_sup_right)` or `sup_le (commutator_mono le_sup_left le_rfl) (commutator_mono le_sup_right le_rfl)`.
evidence: lean_verify_edit replacing lines 150-358 of Mathlib/GroupTheory/Commutator/Basic.lean with `commutator_mono` tagged `@[to_additive (attr := gcongr)]`, the two `_left`/`_right` lemmas deleted and the uses in `commutator_sup_left'` replaced by `by gcongr; exact le_sup_left/right`: outcome `compiled`, no errors. claim: The proof of `commutator_sup_left` uses `[N.Normal]` only to get `⁅H, N⁆ ≤ N` and `⁅K, N⁆ ≤ N` (via `commutator_le_right`). Those follow from the weaker hypotheses `H ≤ normalizer N` and `K ≤ normalizer N`, so the lemma is stated with a stronger assumption than it needs.
requested_change: State the main result with `(hH : H ≤ normalizer N) (hK : K ≤ normalizer N)` instead of `[N.Normal]`, proving `hHKN` as `sup_le (le_normalizer_iff_commutator_le_right.mp hH) (le_normalizer_iff_commutator_le_right.mp hK)`. Keep the `[N.Normal]` form as a corollary using `le_normalizer_of_normal`, or name the general one `commutator_sup_left_of_le_normalizer`.
evidence: lean_verify_edit replacing lines 337-358 of Mathlib/GroupTheory/Commutator/Basic.lean with `commutator_sup_left (H K N) (hH : H ≤ normalizer N) (hK : K ≤ normalizer N)`, the PR proof with only `hHKN` changed as above, and `commutator_sup_right` derived via `commutator_sup_left _ _ _ le_normalizer_of_normal le_normalizer_of_normal`: outcome `compiled`, no errors. claim: `commutator_sup_left'` is a private auxiliary lemma with no docstring. It is declared with `theorem`, which signals an important result, and its prime suggests a variant of `commutator_sup_left`. In fact it is the special case where `⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆` is normal in the whole group, which the main proof uses after restricting to `H ⊔ K ⊔ N`, and the reader has to work that out.
requested_change: Declare it as `private lemma` and add a docstring, e.g. `/-- Auxiliary for `commutator_sup_left`: the distributivity holds when `⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆` is normal in the whole group. -/`.

claim: `commutator_sup_left` is the headline result of the PR but has no docstring. Its 18-line proof has no comment explaining the non-obvious strategy given in the PR description: restrict to `M = H ⊔ K ⊔ N`, where `⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆` is normal, and apply the quotient argument of the auxiliary lemma. The two `suffices` steps and the final normalizer computation are hard to follow without it.
requested_change: Add a docstring stating the result, e.g. `/-- If `N` is normal, the commutator with `N` distributes over `⊔`: `⁅H ⊔ K, N⁆ = ⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆`. -/`. Add short comments before the first `suffices` (the reduction to `M = H ⊔ K ⊔ N`, where `commutator_sup_left'` applies) and before the second (it remains to show that `M` normalizes `⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆`).
evidence: diff.patch and file_read lines 337-355: there is no doc comment and no `--` comment anywhere in the proof. The strategy appears only in the PR description: 'compute `⁅H ⊔ K, N⁆` in the quotient `(H ⊔ K ⊔ N) ⧸ (⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆)`'.
